title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR hardens RBAC v2 by adding enforcement paths for KMS region pinning and improves audit logging for cross-region KMS usage. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require strict data residency guarantees and stronger audit trails when keys or secrets are used across regions. This change follows prior audit-mode rollouts (see ENG-4821) and completes an enforcement step with thorough logging for compliance reviewers. Changes include: 1) new RBAC policy checks that validate KMS key region matches the resource residency metadata; 2) admission-level enforcement toggle with migration helper to surface offending resources; 3) enhanced audit events that include key ARN, requesting principal, tenant region, evaluated policy name, and decision rationale; 4) telemetry counters and dashboards updates for quick incident response; 5) unit and integration tests for enforcement and fallback flows. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked and reviewed (ENG-4821); - [x] Migration helper implemented and smoke-tested on staging; - [x] Backwards-compatible audit-only mode preserved behind feature-flag; - [x] E2E integration tests added to perf-canary and security test suites; - [x] Observability dashboards and alerts updated; - [x] Docs and release notes drafted. Rollout plan: enable audit-only on production for 48h, monitor telemetry, then flip enforcement for opt-in accounts before full rollout by customer cohort. If enforcement causes failures, automatic rollback to audit-only will be possible via the feature-flag and policy remediation UI.
commits: Initial enforcement checks and unit tests
Add audit event schema and serializers
Migration helper to scan existing resources and surface violations
Address review feedback: reduce log verbosity and add sampling for high-frequency operations
review_comments: Ravi Patel: Please ensure the policy evaluation path is cache-safe for high QPS tenants. Observed potential contention in kv-cache in enforcer.go - can we use per-tenant LRU?
Author (Ava Chen): Switched to tenant-scoped small LRU and added instrumentation metrics; CPU impact on staging <1% during our 4h test.
Elena Gomez: Audit events look good but reduce sensitive fields in logs (don't include full key material). Use key ARN and hash when needed.
Author: Removed any key material, replaced with ARN + truncated SHA256 at serializer; updated audit schema accordingly.
Marcus Li: Migration helper scan could generate flood of remediation tasks for large orgs. Suggest rate-limit and a paging UI.
Author: Added rate-limit to migration scanner and a paging cursor; added warning to admin console and documentation.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and harden audit logging. Migration helper added to detect violations. Rollout will start in audit-only mode then move to enforcement per cohort. Admins should review the migration report and policy remediation UI before enabling enforcement.
